title: Husband, wife 72: can't see on her left, bumps into furniture

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 560 Cabrillo Street. It's my wife, she's 72.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She suddenly can't see anything on her left side. She keeps bumping into the furniture. Maybe it's her glasses.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is she awake and talking normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's awake. She's talking, she's just upset.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ten minutes ago, she was fine, she was doing the crossword.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does she take any blood thinners?

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Have her sit down and stay with her.
